description: Instagram Reel script generator: turns one idea into a script someone finishes - 3 hooks from 26 tested formulas scored by a hook scorer, the spoken script, the on-screen text, and a timed beat sheet checked for a slow hook and dead beats. Use when the user wants a Reel script, a short-form video script, hooks, a voiceover, "write a reel about X", "what do I say in this video", "give me hooks", or is about to record without a first line. Pulls the user's best past hooks and outlier transcripts from the IShort MCP (search_my_scripts, list_my_scripts) when connected.
